name: Raika
source:
Raika is a cheerful and humble boy who's a bit sticky-fingered. He loves singing. He lacks a bit of common sense and has a hard time discerning "right" from wrong.

He is a member of NEW DIMENSION's Special for Princess!. He wants to enjoy being an idol alongside the person he admires and have lots of people to listen to his songs.

[Translated from [url=https://ensemble-stars.jp/characters/raika/]official website[/url]]
translation:
Raika is a cheerful and humble boy who's a bit sticky-fingered. He loves singing. He lacks a bit of common sense and has a hard time discerning "right" from wrong.

He is a member of NEW DIMENSION's Special for Princess!. He wants to enjoy being an idol alongside the person he admires and have lots of people to listen to his songs.
